subject: Interview With Library Director Barbara Kerr
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Charlotte and William Bloomberg Medford Public Library Director Barbara Kerr on Medford Happenings. Kerr reviewed the library's post-construction operations, expanded community programming, digital collections, and room reservation services.

items.title: Introduction and Library Construction Retrospective
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced library director Barbara Kerr and showed video clips highlighting the development and funding of the Charlotte and William Bloomberg Medford Public Library.

items.title: Director Responsibilities and Daily Operations
items.summary: Kerr outlined her administrative duties managing staff and facility projects, noting that collection development and ordering books remain her favorite responsibilities.

items.title: Industry Challenges and Community Social Services
items.summary: Kerr addressed nationwide intellectual freedom challenges and described increased local demand for library-hosted social services, including ESOL and citizenship courses.

items.title: Circulation Resources and Streaming Media
items.summary: Kerr detailed the library's catalog offerings, including digital audiobooks, e-books, and video platforms such as Hoopla and Kanopy.

items.title: Public Room Reservations and Software Transition
items.summary: Kerr explained room reservation procedures for the building's 14 meeting spaces and noted an interim booking process while the library transitions to a new software system.

items.title: Community Events and the Mystic Makerspace
items.summary: Kerr reviewed library programming for children, teens, and seniors, highlighting a multi-year Cummings Foundation grant supporting dedicated staffing for the makerspace.

items.title: Volunteer Opportunities and Sign-Ups
items.summary: Kerr provided contact details for general and student community service volunteer positions before Petrella closed the broadcast.
